method: Viewed full-resolution artwork and composed frames; 360x640 start/mid/end samples extracted from the final MP4; cover 3:4 and square crop proof. Instagram continuous playback and actual UI evidence are recorded separately.

checks.anatomy: Four scenes retain chef hat, refrigerator face, mint handle, pineapple ornament, two arms/gloves, compact torso and shoes where visible. Scene 4 naturally occluded by table.

checks.mobileReadability: Dialogue/brand/CTA and ingredient readable in 360px frames. Phone example disclosure is small secondary text and repeated in full in caption.
checks.motion: Scene start/mid/end samples, including 6/9/11.96s corrected scene, show 100 to 103 percent zoom without uncovered edge or clipped head/phone. Fixed balloons do not cover faces.
